title: Advisor, rightsizing and idle resource detection

videos.script: Every subscription has things nobody uses. A disk from a deleted VM. An address attached to nothing. A plan with no apps on it. {{idle}} And things used a little, at a size meant for a lot. {{size}} Azure Advisor points at both. So can a query, which you can run, read and argue with. {{query}} This lesson finds the shop's idle resources and its oversized VM, and then does the part that matters: deciding, with the owner, what to change. {{end}}
